# Rein

> Spending rules for teams and their AI agents, enforced by a Solana program (Anchor 0.31) on
> devnet. The agent proposes a payment. Only the program authorizes it. A team shares one test-USDC
> vault owned by its PDA; each person or agent pays under an on-chain policy (allowance per period,
> cap per payment, payment count, expiry, allowed services). Over a limit the payment is filed as
> Pending and the owner approves it in one transaction. The only services sold are real 0G mainnet
> AI runs by Rein's gateway, paid in devnet test USDC, with the on-chain payment checked first:
> ai-chat, ai-image and ai-voice on TEE-verified providers (0G Compute wallet SDK); ai-claude,
> ai-gpt and ai-video relayed through the 0G Router (0G Private Computer) with no TEE.

Live: https://rein-navy.vercel.app (demo without sign-in: https://rein-navy.vercel.app/demo)
Program id (devnet): F8hK6X1HjNsroUDio4QujwReNpaEFuabyPhMDEXBnjVe
Status: devnet only, test token, no license yet (all rights reserved by the authors).

## Services (all run by Rein on 0G; full table in README.md under "Compute (0G)")

- ai-chat: 0GM-1.0-35B-A3B, one answer up to 1,024 tokens, TEE verified, live (0G Compute wallet SDK only, never the Router)
- ai-image: z-image-turbo, one 1024x1024 image, TEE verified, live (wallet SDK); image served at /api/compute/result/<intent>/blob
- ai-voice: openai/whisper-large-v3, transcript of up to 60 s (3 MB) of uploaded or recorded audio, TEE verified, live (wallet SDK); the audio's sha256 is bound into the quote intent
- ai-claude: claude-haiku-5.5 by default (COMPUTE_CLAUDE_MODEL), relayed through the 0G Router, no TEE, live
- ai-gpt: gpt-5.6-luna by default (COMPUTE_GPT_MODEL), relayed through the 0G Router, no TEE, live
- ai-video: bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast by default (COMPUTE_VIDEO_MODEL), one 4 s 480p 16:9 clip with no audio, relayed through the 0G Router, no TEE, live; an async job (run starts it, result reads finish it), clip served at the same blob route
- Without ZG_ROUTER_API_KEY a Router service is still priced from the public model list, but a paid run is refunded in full (503 not_configured), never faked
- Price of every run: 0G worst case x 1.5, rounded up to the cent, at least 0.01. Live on 2026-11-09: chat 0.01, image 0.02, voice 0.02, claude 0.01, gpt 0.01, video 0.43
- Real paid runs on 2026-11-09 of image, voice, Claude, GPT and video (image and voice verified true; Claude, GPT and video relayed, verified false; chat was not re-run that day): docs/EVIDENCE.md, "Paid 0G runs, 2026-11-09"
- The placeholder services of the first demo (web-search, llm-inference, market-data, gpu-hour, premium-dataset) are suspended on devnet since 2026-11-09. New transactions: docs/EVIDENCE.md; addresses: docs/CONSTANTS.md

## Claims and where each is proven

Transactions marked "earlier evidence" were made before 2026-11-09 against placeholder services that are suspended now; they still show what the program does.

- pay takes a service, never an address: programs/rein/src/lib.rs:695 (payee must equal Service.payee_token); refusal tx (earlier evidence) https://explorer.solana.com/tx/4uZN8NEASQZjW1HyqTPHxaZQ7QfQjL5WeHC94Za8imDnJzpHbzQ2DgD4CNR3uNb4cVCqqhhuzmG9b8znkNo9uZnr?cluster=devnet
- An unknown service has no registry account: programs/rein/src/lib.rs:690; refusal tx (earlier evidence) https://explorer.solana.com/tx/5veVH6qrhhjEyZdTyPAsZuDa9RDkNg6ozBedGnDAduxqtZ9WQ4AWsNxRrHQxbtEYeaM52734tcR8HwkbmwPRr1fA?cluster=devnet
- Spenders hold no SOL, a sponsor pays fees: programs/rein/src/lib.rs:676-678; tx (earlier evidence) https://explorer.solana.com/tx/4Ygd81XkNoDzwUxJoNXKrdPT9PHpyPdKikM6uNsN2Tj49ScGCxricxwVqRNb7w4DXcLen2TACfbtWZ38psdTM6K6?cluster=devnet
- Over a limit, filed Pending: programs/rein/src/lib.rs:400-415 and programs/rein/src/lib.rs:236-240; tx (earlier evidence) https://explorer.solana.com/tx/w1VEqKk3icLuuBUgreeyafsHFQyyiXy9MuJVHETjr6edEnLSkWNjCchvfbJs3MBtm6CJUPgVTprC1ZZNAKoBDbo?cluster=devnet
- Owner approval settles in the same transaction: programs/rein/src/lib.rs:246-285; tx (earlier evidence) https://explorer.solana.com/tx/3PTN2Q5CYHv8NGjfr4FvwX9GG8QSxbq8JvdC9Z4XiwNNY6LYTRptxniY7ETC1PBQ47jJREQ1L6Wxvfes7tLqvHNa?cluster=devnet
- An approval waives a budget, never a stop: programs/rein/src/lib.rs:257-266; test tests/rein.ts:245
- One intent is paid at most once (Payment PDA seeded by spender and intent): programs/rein/src/lib.rs:701; test tests/rein.ts:182
- The vault's authority is the team PDA: programs/rein/src/lib.rs:607-613
- Compute gateway verifies the Payment before running: web/lib/server/compute/core.ts:373-390
- Compute price = 0G worst case x 1.5, at least 0.01: web/lib/server/compute/core.ts:37-44
- Paid runs that cannot happen are refunded once: web/lib/server/compute/core.ts:350-357, web/lib/server/compute/wire.ts:60-99
- First verified 0G production run (payment, devnet): https://explorer.solana.com/tx/2q3PVGSdFgZjanxjjdYokwonesQZdzi8j3EnyYA8TfTRRrxm9P3Bdj565VT9o62A5qC4jR75J3fKuQNEe9kBmMs2?cluster=devnet
- Claim of 0.30 test USDC once per Google account: web/lib/server/claim.ts:41-42 (unique indexes), web/app/api/claim/route.ts:37-48 (owner check)
- Sponsor co-signs only Rein instructions: web/app/api/sponsor/route.ts:115-122
- Agent tools have no address parameter: agent/src/tools.ts:16-52

## Verify in one command

- Unit tests (no chain needed): cd agent && pnpm test; cd web && pnpm test; cd zg-compute && pnpm test
  (last run 2026-11-09: 56, 67 and 186 passing)
- Earlier devnet claims with explorer links (placeholder-era script; its services are suspended now):
  REIN_CLUSTER=devnet REIN_RPC_URL=https://api.devnet.solana.com pnpm evidence
- Program rules (needs a local validator seeded with pnpm seed):
  REIN_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8999 pnpm test:rules (13 tests, last run 2026-11-08)
- Docs references: pnpm docs:check

## Layout

- programs/rein/src/lib.rs: the whole Anchor program (instructions, accounts, errors)
- idl/rein.json: the program IDL used by web and agent
- web/: Next 16 app; web/app/api/* server routes; web/lib/server/* keys, store, claim, compute, cache
- agent/: Groq-hosted buying agent (openai/gpt-oss-120b), tools in agent/src/tools.ts
- zg-compute/: 0G Compute adapter
- scripts/: seed.ts, evidence.ts, compute-setup.ts, pool-setup.ts, check-docs.mjs
- tests/rein.ts: 13 program tests
- docs/: CONSTANTS.md (addresses), EVIDENCE.md (transactions), DESIGN.md, PROVENANCE.md, SUBMISSION.md
